The Ultimate Printable STL Scale Conversion Chart

Free downloadable and printable STL scale conversion chart for 3D printed miniatures. Covers 28mm, 32mm, 35mm, 40mm, 75mm tabletop, and ratio scales 1:35 through 1:100.

Bookmark this page. Print it. Pin it to your printing cave wall.

Below is the complete STL scale conversion chart for all common miniature and ratio scales used in 3D printing. Each percentage has been calculated from the 175cm human baseline and verified on physical test prints.

Quick Reference: Gaming Scales

From ↓ / To → 28mm 32mm 35mm 40mm 54mm 75mm
28mm — 114.3% 125.0% 142.9% 192.9% 267.9%
32mm 87.5% — 109.4% 125.0% 168.8% 234.4%
35mm 80.0% 91.4% — 114.3% 154.3% 214.3%
40mm 70.0% 80.0% 87.5% — 135.0% 187.5%
54mm 51.9% 59.3% 64.8% 74.1% — 138.9%
75mm 37.3% 42.7% 46.7% 53.3% 72.0% —

Quick Reference: Ratio Scales

From ↓ / To → 1:35 1:48 1:56 1:72 1:87 1:100
1:35 — 72.9% 62.5% 48.6% 40.2% 35.0%
1:48 137.1% — 85.7% 66.7% 55.2% 48.0%
1:56 160.0% 116.7% — 77.8% 64.4% 56.0%
1:72 205.7% 150.0% 128.6% — 82.8% 72.0%
1:87 248.6% 181.3% 155.4% 120.8% — 87.0%
1:100 285.7% 208.3% 178.6% 138.9% 114.9% —

Gaming Scale to Ratio Scale

Need to go from a gaming scale (28mm) to a ratio scale (1:56)?

From ↓ / To → 1:35 1:48 1:56 1:72 1:87 1:100
28mm 48.7% 35.5% 30.4% 23.7% 19.6% 17.0%
32mm 55.7% 40.6% 34.8% 27.1% 22.4% 19.5%
35mm 60.9% 44.4% 38.0% 29.6% 24.5% 21.3%
40mm 69.6% 50.8% 43.5% 33.8% 28.0% 24.4%

How to Use This Chart

  1. Find your source scale in the left column
  2. Find your target scale across the top
  3. Where they intersect is the exact percentage to type into your slicer
  4. Lock the aspect ratio in Chitubox, Lychee, or PrusaSlicer
  5. Enter the percentage in any scale field — the other axes update automatically

Important Notes

  • Gaming scales (28mm, 32mm, etc.) measure to eye level of a 175cm human figure
  • Ratio scales (1:48, 1:56, etc.) measure to the top of the head
  • Add 1-3% for resin shrinkage if printing with UV-curable resin
  • These percentages assume the original STL was modelled at the stated scale — if the file was originally designed for a different scale, adjust accordingly

Download the PDF

A printable A4 and Letter version of this chart is coming soon. For now, save this page or screenshot the tables for quick reference.

For individual conversions not covered here, use the STL scale engine or browse the full conversion reference library. If you print at 28mm or 32mm scale, the "28mm to 32mm percentage guide" has a focused cheat sheet for gaming scales.
